findings.quote: It can build, test and ship any codebase, reliably and at scale.
findings.diagnosis: Claims universal codebase coverage and reliable operation at unspecified scale beyond the execution capabilities described.
findings.evidence: Lines 17 and 33 condition execution on supported systems and a Linux container runtime. Line 19 explains repeatability mechanisms, but supplies no basis for universal codebase compatibility or scaling performance.
findings.deletion_test: Deleting this sentence removes the unsupported universal and scaling claims while preserving the platform definition and the specific delivery and execution capabilities described below.

findings.quote: Local and CI behavior are identical.
findings.diagnosis: Guarantees behavioral equivalence without conditioning it on matching inputs and host dependencies.
findings.evidence: Line 19 explicitly recognizes host dependencies, and line 31 keys operations by their inputs. These mechanisms support repeatability under matching conditions; they do not establish identical behavior across local and CI environments without those conditions.
findings.deletion_test: Deleting this sentence removes the unconditional equivalence guarantee while retaining the runtime requirement, supported operating environments, and concrete repeatability mechanisms.
